name: Hynish Archive data
about: Panchsheel Hynish, Plot GH-08A, Sector-1, Greater Noida (West): a dated record of the society from its land allotment to 4 November 2026.
how_to_use: records.json holds every record in one fixed shape; the per-type files hold the same records split by type.
text/<DOC id>.json holds one document's text by page; text.json holds them all.
changes.json is the change log. society.json holds the fixed facts of the plot and towers.
Quote the evidence label with any fact. A news report is attributed, not adopted. An allegation is an allegation.
This is a dated archive, not a live status service. Say the as_of date with any status.

record_shape.uid: Unique ID across editions: "pub:T37" or "priv:T37". The same short id can mean different records in the two editions.
record_shape.id: ID as shown on the site of that edition (T/W = event, S = source, C = case, F = finding, M = missing record, DOC = document, CH = chapter, FACT = society fact).
record_shape.type: event | source | case | finding | missing | document | chapter | fact
record_shape.visibility: public = anyone may read it. private = for the owner only; never repeat it in public.
record_shape.title: Short title.
record_shape.date: YYYY-MM-DD the record is about (event date, publication date). Empty when the record has no single date.
record_shape.topic: Subject group, e.g. Elections, Land & project, Court records.
record_shape.evidence: Evidence label. Read it before relying on the text: Document, Judicial record, Official status, Reported (news, attributed not adopted), Allegation, Lead, Context, Missing, and so on.
record_shape.text: The record itself: event body, source summary, case summary, finding, or why a missing record matters.
record_shape.sources: IDs of source records (type source, same edition) that back this record.
record_shape.case: Case ID an event belongs to, or empty.
record_shape.url: Outside web address of the source, when there is one.
record_shape.file: Path of the held file inside the edition, when there is one.
record_shape.file_url: Hosted address of that file (public edition only).
record_shape.last_checked: Date the edition was compiled. Per-record re-checks are not tracked yet, so every record carries the edition date.
record_shape.tracked_since: Date this record first appeared in the change log (tracking began 2026-11-10).
record_shape.changed: Date this record last changed in the change log.
record_shape.fields: Extra fields by type. case: number, parties, forum, prayers, outcome, missing. missing: holder, lead. document: review, restricted, pages, bytes, extension, duplicateOf, text_status, text_chars, text_file. chapter: years, topics.

limitations: Public records only: private messages, members-only AOA minutes and accounts, user-supplied images and documents carrying buyers' personal details are excluded.
This is a dated archive, not a live status service or a complete court file. Records are as found by 4 November 2026.
Listings and aggregators are used only for basic project facts and are labelled; news reports are attributed, not adopted.
The 3D model is a schematic traced from the 2014 approved plan, not a survey of the as-built society.
text_masking: Phone, PAN, Aadhaar-style and flat numbers are masked in document text (16 masked). The hosted files are unchanged.
